implementation: coordination substrate: a validated decision-layer schema (RATE / classification / waiver / disposition)

declared_properties.statement: A RATE decision event carries a typed rate in {Reframe,Adapt,Terminate,Execute} and a per-objective diagnosis with a type in the pinned set and a falsification_condition; the authoritative publisher refuses a decision event missing or malforming these.
Readiness (zero contradicted-and-open) is computed over classification alone; a row classified contradicted whose disposition names no closure evidence is open regardless of applicability or waiver.
A waiver/exclusion is dated, cited (authority and tracking_ref), and carries an expiry; an expired waiver is refused; a waiver never removes a contradicted row from the open count.
A disposition binds the digest of the governing rubric/order it was judged against and is staled when that digest changes.

controls.firing_condition: a decision event whose rate is outside the pinned set, or whose diagnosis lacks a pinned type or a falsification_condition
witness_inputs: diagnosis omitted while rate is Reframe
permitted_inputs: rate Reframe with diagnosis.type invalid_measure and a falsification_condition
rate Execute with a delayed_effect diagnosis

controls.firing_condition: a readiness computation that lets a contradicted row leave the open count via applicability or waiver without closure evidence
witness_inputs: a contradicted row marked applicability=non-current with a valid basis and no closure evidence, asserted ready
a contradicted row covered by a waiver, asserted ready
permitted_inputs: a contradicted row whose disposition names closure evidence (now enforced) counts closed
a contradicted row whose disposition cites a retired authority with evidence counts closed-by-retirement

prohibited_side_effects: reporting ready with an open contradiction

controls.firing_condition: a waiver with no expiry, or an expired waiver admitted, or a waiver used to zero a contradicted-and-open count
witness_inputs: a waiver whose expires_at is in the past, admitted
a waiver missing authority or tracking_ref
permitted_inputs: a dated, cited, unexpired waiver that suppresses a warning but leaves the contradicted-and-open count unchanged

prohibited_side_effects: treating a waiver as a permanent exit

controls.firing_condition: a disposition that does not bind its governing rubric/order digest, or a disposition treated as current after that digest changed
witness_inputs: a disposition with no governing_digest field
a disposition whose governing_digest no longer matches the current rubric
a rubric edit that leaves dependent dispositions marked current
permitted_inputs: a disposition binding governing_digest equal to the current rubric digest, marked current

prohibited_side_effects: carrying a disposition as current against a moved standard

residual_unknowns.statement: Whether a diagnosis is TRUE is undecidable; the schema validates its shape and consistency, never its correctness.
residual_unknowns.reversible_default: emit diagnosis_truth: not_established and route the underdetermined case to discriminate, never validate truth
residual_unknowns.disconfirming_signal: a downstream reader treats a schema-valid diagnosis as an established world-claim

residual_unknowns.statement: Which implementation is authoritative is unresolved: the 149-test library (/srv/coordination-substrate) and the live tool (coordination/tools/publish_bridge_event.py) are divergent, and the fleet runs the latter.
residual_unknowns.reversible_default: land this schema in the tool the fleet actually runs, and mark the library reference-only until reconciled
residual_unknowns.disconfirming_signal: the schema is added to the library while the fleet keeps publishing through the unvalidated tool

residual_unknowns.statement: Completeness of the classified claim set is a discovery claim, not decidable by the schema.
residual_unknowns.reversible_default: report coverage NOT ESTABLISHED; the meta-gate self-enforces new gates forward
residual_unknowns.disconfirming_signal: a known must/never appears with no row

attacks.attempt: classify a claim contradicted with current-state evidence, then record applicability non-current with a compliant basis so it leaves the readiness count with nothing closed (James C1)
attacks.oracle: readiness counts the row as open because its disposition names no closure evidence, independent of applicability

disposition.rationale: readiness is computed over classification alone; applicability and waiver cannot remove a contradicted row from the open count

attacks.attempt: use a waiver as a permanent exit by omitting expiry, or reuse an expired one
attacks.oracle: a waiver missing or past expires_at is refused; an unexpired waiver suppresses a warning but does not change the open count

disposition.rationale: waivers are dated, cited, and expiring, and never zero the contradicted-and-open count

attacks.attempt: correct the rubric after a disposition is published so the disposition stays 'current' against a moved standard (James C4)
attacks.oracle: changing the governing rubric digest stales every dependent disposition

disposition.rationale: the disposition binds the governing digest and stales on its change; this closes the definition-of-passing staleness gap at the substrate

attacks.attempt: publish a decision with a well-formed envelope but a diagnosis that is a bare enum tag with no falsification_condition
attacks.oracle: the validator refuses a diagnosis without a pinned type and a falsification_condition

disposition.rationale: C-001 requires the pinned type and a falsifier; a bare tag is refused, matching the assess discipline

attacks.attempt: land the schema in the library while the fleet keeps publishing through the unvalidated tool, so nothing changes for the fleet
attacks.oracle: the enforced seam is the implementation the fleet actually runs

disposition.rationale: U-002 makes the seam the live tool; a library-only change is recorded as not discharging the fleet-facing obligation
